general_information.Description: This is Skillful Reading 1 course, extracted from Skillful reading and writing 2 and intended to use for Upper-intermediate students. After the course, students can be able to use reading techniques (previewing, scanning, skimming, etc.) to comprehend reading passages related to academic topics such as psychology, Sociology, Biology, Chemistry, Business Studies.
general_information.StudentTasks: - Attend more than 80% of contact hours in order to be accepted to the final examination - Actively participate in class activities - Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class - Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose - Read the textbook in advance - Access the course website (www.cms.fpt.edu.vn) for up-to-date information and material of the course, for online supports from teachers and other students and for practicing and assessment.

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Infer pronouns used in the reading texts
Understand the annotations in the reading texts
Determine main ideas and support details
Use a chart to organise notes
Understand the information from charts, graphs and sequence of the ideas
